design.event_handling: Retain all asynchronous bp messages drained by MonitorClient.call during run/wait. They are secondary diagnostics, not a success gate.
design.primary_stop_marker: After a successful run RPC acknowledgement, issue wait_for_stop with a bounded server timeout shorter than the client read deadline by 750ms. Accept only reason=breakpoint with a bp_id from the current set_breakpoint acknowledgements and exact matching PC.
design.request_epoch_safety: MonitorClient request IDs must show wait_for_stop immediately follows run (wait ID equals run ID + 1). The observer records a local run epoch; monitor.c resets last_stop to NONE before the run acknowledgement, so the synchronous stop result belongs to the next run, not the previous stop.
design.scope: Observer and E6 evidence only. No production monitor/client, ROM/source/build, protocol, loader, mapping, profile, phase, or deadline changes.
design.success_marker: All 87 helper bytes match authored/staged/physical/mapped image; wait_for_stop reports an acknowledged expected helper breakpoint and source-proven caller/return with PC and stack checks; resident $C116 is reached and live bytes match the current artifact.
design.transport_timeout: If run/wait call errors at transport level, do not issue another call on the primary socket/makefile; use the already-open secondary capture. A returned reason=timeout is a healthy RPC response and permits the bounded read-only primary state/list/drop-counter snapshot before secondary pause.

reassessment.parent_decision: Parent reviewed and approved the exact v3 observer hash for one deterministic 45-second boundary experiment after a full offline guard; all other scope and stop rules remain unchanged.
reassessment.v2_finding: The primary event wait did not retain a return bp event. Independent pre-pause state/list plus live code and stack prove the dynamically executed return breakpoint ID 11 stopped at $15D5; event delivery versus unread data after the timed-out stream is not resolved.

runtime_authorization.experiment: One deterministic v3 helper-caller-return and resident C116 boundary experiment.
runtime_authorization.failure_rule: Stop on any missing marker or timeout. Retain independent capture and raw receipts. No retry, no succession runtime, and no source/build/protocol/boundary/profile/deadline changes without new parent reassessment.
runtime_authorization.success_marker: All 87 helper bytes match authored/staged/physical/mapped image; acknowledged expected helper breakpoint plus source-proven caller/return and PC/stack identity; resident C116 reached and live bytes match current artifact.
